channel.title: Pier & Point · 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East): At the May 17, 2016 OCII…
item.description: At the May 17, 2016 OCII Commission meeting, staff said Nibbi Bros. would be working on Mission Bay 6 East starting within 9-12 months. The minutes do not say Nibbi had been awarded the contract, so the page no longer lists it as the general contractor. Source: https://sfocii.org/files/minutes/2026-08/20160517.pdf.

item.title: Correction · 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East): Long 'At a glance' values were…
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East): 1300 Fourth Street's summary now…
item.description: 1300 Fourth Street's summary now notes the SomiSomi business registration (Feb 2025), which is not an opening. Source: DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis).

item.title: Correction · 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East): Happy Lemon (1320 4th St) and…
item.description: Happy Lemon (1320 4th St) and SomiSomi (1350 4th St) were listed as open tenants, but the only evidence was business registrations (Happy Lemon from July 2019, with two earlier registrations at the address ended, one marked administratively closed; SomiSomi from February 2025). A registration does not show a storefront opened, and no page showing either operating was found, so both are removed from the tenant list. The record's open questions list the sources read. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis; Pier & Point editorial review.

item.title: Correction · 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East): SocketSite's August 2016 piece…
item.description: SocketSite's August 2016 piece is now described as a forecast that construction would start in late September 2016, not a report that groundbreaking happened, and the 'under construction' milestone was removed. TNDC is described as the owner per Ventura Partners and as the units' manager per SocketSite, not as developer, and Ventura Partners is called the commercial property manager. Happy Lemon and SomiSomi now show no opening date, because a DataSF business registration does not show that a storefront opened, and their timeline entries were reworded the same way. The OCII entries now say an option to ground lease was authorized, give the 34 resident and 5 commercial parking spaces without adding them to a 39 total of our own, and no longer attach the 2019 completion to a 2016 schedule. The status notes cite Ventura Partners for the 2019 completion, and the Wikimedia photo credit no longer names an author or a flight the file page does not state. Source: SocketSite, 2016-08 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2016/08/affordable-mission-bay-development-about-to-break-ground.html); Ventura Partners, 1300-1360 Fourth Street project page (https://venturapartners.com/our-projects/1300-1360-fourth-street/); OCII Commission minutes, 2016-05-17 (https://sfocii.org/files/minutes/2026-08/20160517.pdf); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis); Wikimedia Commons file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).
